features.feature: Today greets by the time of day and About me's first name, with the date, the meetings, the tasks on the user and how many are late

Your day lists where you'll be: today's meetings (but declined ones) and calls in time order with the line "now", a line each — time (violet the next — the line holding the first meeting you go to that isn't over, the one Next meeting shows — amber a choice), a bar (solid: going; dashed: no reply, maybe), its threads and its reason: next, no reply, maybe, "instead of …" and "N skipped" for an overlap one you accepted wins, "N others at once" for two you accepted, your work in a free gap of 45 minutes or more, its minutes (new minutes with what they hold, writing, at HH:MM, failed — try again), prep, import the Teams transcript, recording not available for Zoom/Meet; Show N skipped; ⋯ or right-click opens Calendar's menu for it, a click its card on the right; the greeting counts the meetings you go to; the skipped, shown, in time order; a list cut by its card fades at the bottom while there is more; it opens with the row before now whole at its top (late in the day, the nearest whole row)

My work · this week lists the tasks due by the week's end or late (late first) with whose they are, a date icon and the thread; a card opens its details; its icons close it (asking first) or open the Claude dialog

Needs you now lists what waits on the user from Teams and mail in the last 24 h (burning first), with Reply (Teams' logo or an envelope) and My work's ✦: its Claude dialog on the item itself (no task made) — Work on it types the item's link (echo://needs/<id>, read with `echoctl read`) into the Claude panel, Yolo hands it over in the background; either way it then leaves the list; I'll do it (a task in a thread) and Won't do (a dialog that needs a comment: why, or who it's for; Cancel keeps the item) from ⌘K; each action named in its label and tooltip
Cards sent to Today by routines or plugins show until Got it
A day with nothing says "A quiet day"; ⌘K on Today acts on its items

Won't do runs Claude in the background with no tools (the item's thread's AI profile or the default), the item's words as data and the comment as the only instructions; Today → Asks shows "Won't do · for X: why", working, or why it failed; no message unless the comment asks for one

A Won't do whose comment asks for a reply or a forward gets a draft in Asks, back by the item's own Teams chat or mail, with Send, Edit and Drop: nothing goes out before Send (through Microsoft 365, as Read and reply); Drop leaves nothing

After a failed calendar sync (it keeps the last agenda) Your day lists no meeting of an earlier day as today's, and once a sync has failed today with no good one today it says the calendar couldn't be read today (not before the day's first sync)

Today's widgets: echoctl widget list gives the catalog (id, part, label, kind, sizes S/M/L, hug or fill, temporal) and widget show a widget's data — the same Today gets (/api/today is made from the widgets' providers; /api/widgets the catalog); a temporal widget's data says empty when it has nothing; an unknown id names widget list

Today's layout on this computer (today-layout.json): which widgets, in what order, rows and sizes; echoctl today shows it, add / move (before, after, above, below) / size / remove / reset change it, refusing an unknown widget, a size it doesn't take, one not drawn on Today yet; the page draws its parts in that order, a row's widgets side by side; the default is Today as it was

Today lays itself out by its own width: 1–3 columns (fold under 340 px a column, unfold at 380), each row of its layout filling the width by its widgets' sizes (S 1, M 2, L 3), a row too wide narrowing its widest first then wrapping, an empty temporal widget taking no space; re-laid when the menu, the right panel or the window changes it; nothing reorders

Next meeting on Today (core:calendar.next, put on with echoctl today): S the time, subject and buttons (Show prep or Prepare, Join & record with its language); M also what is expected from you; L the prep brought to the front — walk in knowing (In short, up to 3 expected), who's coming (the invite's answers, a newcomer named), ask them (up to 2 open questions), records with the call, Open prep / Ask Claude about it; under way it says Now; none left today, no widget and no gap

Your day as a calendar (core:calendar.calendar: the hours down, 9–18 at least, a block a meeting in its lane, overlaps side by side, not answered / maybe dashed, the line now, opens scrolled to now) and as a strip (core:calendar.strip: the day in one bar, two at once half height, hour ticks, the line now), put on Today with echoctl today; their blocks act as Your day's lines: click → the card on the right, right-click → Calendar's menu

Edit Today: a pencil in the head frames each widget (grip, name, its sizes, ×; content inert; an empty temporal one says what it is); drag a widget onto another's top or bottom quarter for a new row above / below, its left or right half to sit before / after it, or onto the end for a last row; Add a widget on the right (search, parts, a row a widget with Add or on Today, the picked one previewed at a size it takes, Add at that size or drag it in); Reset to the default; Done; every change is the layout file echoctl today edits; by keyboard each frame's ← ↑ ↓ → move it (the focus stays on the moved widget's button), × leaves the focus on a neighbour, "Add a widget" in the head brings the panel back; a frame never overflows its row

The day's choices (core:calendar.choices, temporal, put on with echoctl today): meetings you accepted at once (not over) with the one Echo suggests and why (you organise it, in a thread, the longer, the earlier) and Keep buttons — Keep declines the others after a second click naming them; invites still to answer with Echo's suggestion (decline when you go elsewhere then, naming the one it suggests keeping; accept when free) and Accept / Maybe / Decline; an answer goes to the organiser through Echo's Microsoft 365 sign-in only on the click (m365::event_respond, refused in runs), the agenda takes it at once; a failure says why

Threads at a glance (core:tasks.glance, M/L) and Done this week (core:tasks.done, S/M), put on with echoctl today: each open thread's tasks as a traffic-light bar — done this week (green), to do (amber), waiting on someone or blocked (red) — and its total, busiest first (M 5, L 10, the rest in Threads), its name opening its Work; the tasks done since Monday counted, at M the latest four with their thread, each opening its details; echoctl widget show gives the same data

A plugin's widgets on Today: declared in echo-plugin.json `widgets` (id, label, about, kind stat|stats|list|status|card, sizes, height, refresh at least 60 s; checked at install; the sheet says 'Adds N widgets you can put on Today'), in the catalog as plugin:<id>:<widget> under the plugin's name, put on with echoctl today or Add a widget; data from the host half's ctx.widgets.provide (asked by Echo in the background, 5 s, again after refresh) or set / clear (cleared: off Today), the last answer drawn at once (a failed ask keeps it, dated); Echo draws each kind, the plugin's text escaped, links only to echo://, data it can't draw says why
